verdict.rationale: The OCR layer gives per-page blocks with paragraph-level bounding boxes, structural labels and extracted content in reading order. It also offers block- and word-level confidence scores. Together these provide raw provenance that humans or agents could cite. However, structured field extraction (document_annotation) returns an annotation of the entire document, and nothing shows that individual extracted fields are linked back to a page, bounding box or source snippet. Agents would have to map fields to blocks themselves. Missing for 10: per-field page number, per-field bounding box and source-snippet linkage in document_annotation output, word-level coordinates, and independent corroboration of grounding/citation workflows.
